title: Costume Structure 솔로 #025 · black glamour · 마녀 × 컷아웃 바디콘 (다이아몬드 파임) · stretch velvet · 힙 팝 · 봄 정원 테라스 · 글래스 스킨
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

a deep ebony-brown complexion, early 20s goddess, black glamour physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — an extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person; a dramatically impossible waist-to-hip ratio dominates her silhouette: a colossal heavy bust, an extremely sharply cinched waist pulled in far tighter than the waistline of any of her other curves, and then enormous round hips flaring out to a width many times greater than that narrow waist; gigantic soft thighs pressed together, very thick soft arms, a gigantic rounded rear; her head looks small on top of her massive body; not a plus-size model, not evenly proportioned; her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other, long wavy golden blonde hair — wearing a skin-tight micro witch bodycon mini dress of ultra-thin deep purple stretch velvet with thin shoulder straps and a silver crescent-moon clasp at her throat, the front zipper pulled down the center of her chest to just above the diamond, the two sides of the stretch velvet fully covering her bust, a large diamond-shaped cutout down the center of her stomach from under her bust to her lower belly with her navel inside it, the skin inside bare, the stretch velvet remaining at her waist sides and flanks, a plain ultra-high slit cut up the right side of the dress from the hem to her hip bone, the slit baring her whole right thigh and the side of her right hip, the hem ending just below her hip bones with small silver stars sewn along it, a micro length hardly longer than a belt, her arms and legs bare, the stretch velvet shrink-wrapped onto her body like a second skin, fully opaque, her face and hands bare. Real photographic skin on her face, neck, arms, hands, stomach, thighs and legs, with visible pores and fine grain, fine peach-fuzz hairs and a faint natural flush on her cheeks and chest, a light scatter of faint freckles across her shoulders and upper arms and a small mole near her collarbone. The garments cling like a second skin and show real material behaviour: the thin stretch velvet molded so closely that it shows the soft relief of her collarbones, her hip bones and the gentle rise of her bust and hips, the crescent-moon clasp, the small silver stars and the sharp clean edges of the diamond cutout, a soft velvet pile that shifts from deep purple to near black in the folds. Pose: strong hip pop left, both hands pressing outer hips outward arching back to extreme — most extreme black glamour silhouette ever displayed.
Footwear: heels of the most absurdly extreme height imaginable, pointed platform stiletto pumps made of glossy deep purple leather, each with a razor-thin tapered heel a full forty inches tall and a twelve-inch hidden front platform, her feet arched fully vertical on the very tips of her toes like a dancer on pointe, her legs stretched impossibly long and her whole body lifted far above the ground on them as if standing on stilts.
Nails: the longest nails physically imaginable, coffin nails each as long as her forearm is wide, in deep purple lacquer with a high polish.
Jewelry: a wide gold waist chain resting over the carved curve of her hips, a long layered gold necklace falling between her breasts, and a fine gold chain looped around her thigh above the knee. Jewelry is metal and pearl only, worn on the body, nothing added to her face or ears.
Face: her face is bare of any garment — real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Black woman with strong, striking features, a broad nose and full lips, an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, makeup: very dewy glass skin with a strong luminous highlight on the cheekbones, nose bridge and forehead, a rosy blush, glossy coral lips.

Background: a bright spring garden terrace of pale stone with blooming tulip beds, a low trimmed hedge, a standard-height garden gate and a bench, under a soft overcast sky with gentle diffused light, lit by natural light with soft shadows, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus. ONE woman only. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the whole figure from the soles of the boots to the top of her head completely visible, with the door, railing or steps beside her at normal human scale so the extreme heel height reads at a glance, the towering heels clearly separating the boot soles from the floor. This is one single photograph taken with one camera at one moment, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/5.6, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph. Portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
